newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson, Coors in interim deal.
newsitem.headline: Molson, Coors in interim deal.

text.p: Molson Cos Ltd said on Thursday that its 40 percent-owned Molson Breweries reached an interim deal with Coors Brewing Co regarding the licensing of Coors products in Canada, after a panel ruling on October 18 that terminated the previous agreement effective April 2, 1993.
Molson and Coors agreed that Molson would continue to brew and market Coors products at least through June 30, 1997.
Under the deal, Coors would get additional amounts that would cut Molson Breweries earnings by about C$15 million for the period from October 18, 1996 to June 30, 1997.
The companies said the agreement did not apply to their respective positions on damages for the period from April 2, 1993 to October 18, 1996.
Molson Breweries and Coors said they were continuing discussions about a new longer term arrangement covering the production and sales of Coors brands in Canada.
Molson Breweries is owned 40 percent each by Molson Cos and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd and 20 percent by Philip Morris Cos Inc's Miller Brewing unit.
